channel.title: Violations Watch: new incidents
channel.description: New entries in the open log of reported violations of international humanitarian and human rights law. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: RSF gunmen shoot dead three civilians in the Abu Qalb area of West Kordofan amid reported ethnically motivated attacks (Kordofan Monitor)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Abu Qalb, West Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces. Reported casualties: 3 killed. Disputed or caveats: Single rights-monitor statement. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1697

item.title: Houthi shelling hits an ambulance in Sabr al-Mawadim district, Taiz, on 21 Nov, killing one and wounding six; another civilian injured (Yemeni government says)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Sabr al-Mawadim, Taiz, Yemen. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Killing of civilians, Attacks on healthcare & aid. Alleged perpetrator: Houthi forces (Ansar Allah). Reported casualties: 1 killed, 7 injured. Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. Disputed or caveats: Figures from the internationally recognised government (a party to the conflict). 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1686

item.title: Bandits attack a Niger State community, behead the village head, kill at least five others and burn homes; reprisal attacks reported in Wawa
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Niger State, Nigeria. Types: Killing of civilians, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Armed bandits. Reported casualties: 6+ killed. Disputed or caveats: Casualty figures vary across reports (village head plus five or several others). 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1691
